build_NLayerDiscriminator: build a PatchGAN discriminator model with configurable input channels, filters, and conv layers
run_hinge_d_loss: run the hinge discriminator loss calculation given real and fake logits tensors
run_vanilla_d_loss: run the vanilla discriminator loss calculation using softplus on real and fake logits
run_non_saturating_loss: run the non-saturating GAN discriminator loss using sigmoid cross entropy with logits
run_weights_init: run weight initialization on a module setting normal distribution for Conv and BatchNorm layers
